## What ran green — recorded in the registry journal

- **fetch** — `SIG_EXPORT_AS_OF=2026-11-25T14:08:17Z export.sh --apply
  fetch` synced the staged prefix to `exports/out/national` (1,422 files,
  4.3 GiB); `manifest.json` sha256 `39e6549b…8153c` == the journaled
  `export_manifest_sha256`; exclusions 0/0/0; `web/evaluation.json`
  `sig.resolution-eval/1` provisional.
- **cut** — event `registry/events/000006-20261125T163824-cut-root.json`
  (16:38:24Z, `host_clock.ok`, clear of the 03:00–06:30Z band + the
  AR-3 12-06→12-13 freeze).
- **build** — event `000007-20261125T175232-built-p-31371dfb.json` →
  `p-31371dfb4b2b26453f818fefd311ea07be50ef8413aa9185be1ede927a773a8b`,
  `sig-2026-11-25.1`, `environment=production`. One refusal en route
  (auto-allocated label wrote `labels.json` under the held lock →
  `stale-generation` refuse — verbatim in the ledger; recovered with
  `--label` + `--break-lock`, stranded allocation `sig-2026-11-25.1`
  recorded, never hidden).
- **integrity re-validation** — `sig-exports release validate` over the
  built tree: `state=complete`, `failures=[]`, **462,494 artifacts**
  hashed byte-for-byte.

## What stopped at verified bounds — recorded, never smoothed

- **Web dist builds → `ERR_STRING_TOO_LONG`** (verified, not projected):
  `getStatementIndex()` (`web/src/lib/data.ts:2029`) `readFileSync`s every
  `<comp>/statements.jsonl`; `osm_physical/statements.jsonl` is
  **1,013,125,905 B** > V8's `0x1fffffe8` char cap — reproduced verbatim
  via the package's own `vitest` under pinned node v24.21.0. Every page
  family that calls it (entity / claim / explore / disagreements / watch)
  kills the build. Deeper bound recorded: the readers are non-memoized —
  ~258k entity pages × full ~1.9 GB corpus re-parse + per-claim basis
  rebuild = quadratic. Both real builds sat in `generating static routes`
  for hours at 0 emitted routes. **`sites` was never invoked** — the verb
  would journal a `sites` event over partial trees; running it would
  fabricate a record. → **`D-P37.65a-2`** (kind F).
- **`release stage` measured + died**: dry-run plan = 462,497 objects
  (`r/`+`releases/` only; ~700k with the missing `v/`/`s/` trees).
  `--apply` measured **~0.014 obj/s** (8 objects in ~9.6 min — ~7 serial
  GCS calls/object, each paying a measured 5–6 s `gcloud` ADC token
  subprocess), then **died on its own** at `GcsError: no GCS access token
  available` — a token call exceeding the client's 15 s timeout is a hard
  exit, not a retry (`logs/…/11-stage.txt` verbatim). `staged` never
  emitted; the lock stays held `{verb:stage, 19:41:59Z}` + 8 create-if-
  absent residue objects — the append-only forensic state a re-run
  resumes over. Projection at the measured rate ≈ ~380 d; at attempt-1's
  0.37 obj/s ≈ 14.5 d partial / ~22 d full — infeasible either way. →
  **`D-P37.65a-3`** (kind F).
- **live-crawl never reached** — no `staged` candidate. Even a completed
  stage hits V14 (no prior `latest.json`) + V15 (no `sig.quality-report/1`)
  as blocking skips per SIG-ENG-042.
- Staging origins still IAM-only: unauthenticated probes → **403** on
  `sig-web-staging` + `sig-api-staging` (`07-unauth-probe.txt`).
